• **(1) python-jose — ignore now, migrate later.** Sound. The vuln needs two preconditions: (a) decode without explicit `algorithms` restriction, (b) verifier using a key the attacker possesses (a *public* key abused as HMAC secret). You verified (a) fails on all 12 files and (b) fails by design — `jwt_secret_key` is a server secret, never a public key. What would make it false: any future `jwt.decode` without `algorithms=`, any key sourced from config/JWKS/request input, or `jwt_algorithm` ever set to an asymmetric alg (then the pub/priv confusion class opens). Write exactly those three as re-evaluation triggers in the ignore doc. Migration is a 12-file auth change — mixing it into a CI-unblock PR violates one-PR-one-concern; the OWED line is right.

  **(2) Safe to ship, with proof.** multidict 6.7.1→6.9.1 skips 6.8.x — fine, aiohttp/yarl accept `<7`, but it carries C-ext changes: require the full backend pytest green, not just compile. fsspec/datasets and langgraph-sdk patch bumps are low-risk; werkzeug 3.1.9 is a patch. Required proof before arming: CI green (pytest + the audit job itself), a smoke that imports the app, does an HS256 encode/decode round-trip, and boots uvicorn; post-deploy (auto on merge): `/health` + one authenticated endpoint 200. The zero-transitive-move probe is the right evidence — keep it in the PR body.

  **(3) Ignore both ids.** CVE-2026-85394 and GHSA-3qf3-8w2g-rqmx are one advisory; pip-audit's DB (PyPA vs OSV) can surface either. Ignoring only one risks staying red. One doc entry, two `--ignore-vuln` flags — not over-ignoring.

  **(4) Gaps:** tie the ignore to `python-jose==3.5.0` explicitly (re-audit on version change); add an expiry/re-check date, ignores fossilize; confirm `uv pip compile` used CI's exact Python/platform flags or hashes drift on other runners; Bites line = "Backend Static" job green on origin/main post-merge.

  VERDICT: ADOPT-WITH-CHANGES: ignore both CVE+GHSA ids, pin ignore to jose==3.5.0 with expiry date, full pytest + jwt round-trip + post-deploy auth smoke before arming
